descriptions: I’m software engineer with 10+ years of experience in developing web applications and services and 4 years of experience in leading small developer teams technically as well as communication between technical and non-technical leadership.

Don't let my degree fool you! I didn't stop learning after I graduated. I have a passion for learning and I am always looking for new challenges to improve my skills. I'm motivated, curious about the world and have a keen eye for detail. I own what I do and I believe in learning from my failures rather than never failing at all.
As cheesy as it sounds, I believe in the power of teamwork. Ubuntu.
